name: Valdemar
source:
Quaestor Valdemar is one of the five members of the Vesuvian court. They are the head physician of the palace and Julian Devorak's former boss. They are the most independent of the courtiers and refuse to listen to Countess Nadia and Procurator Volta multiple times. They have a sadistic and morbid personality.

[From [url=https://thearcanagame.fandom.com/wiki/Valdemar]The Arcana Wiki[/url]]
